children: RNS Number : 2720U  Sage Group PLC (The)  10 September 2026
10 September 2026
The Sage Group plc
Admission to trading of €500 million bond

The Sage Group plc (FTSE: SGE) ("Sage"), a leader in accounting, financial, HR and payroll technology for small and mid-sized businesses, announces that the following transferable securities have been admitted to trading on 10 September 2026 on the London Stock Exchange’s main market:

Sage’s €500,000,000 4.2805 per cent. Notes due 10 March 2032 (ISIN: XS3491327378) guaranteed by Sage Treasury Company Limited (the "Guarantor") issued under the £3,000,000,000 Euro Medium Term Note Programme (the "Notes").

Full information on Sage, the Guarantor and the offer of the Notes is only available on the basis of the base prospectus dated 5 February 2026 (the "Base Prospectus") as supplemented by the supplemental prospectus dated 28 August 2026 (the "Supplement"), read together with the final terms published by the Issuer on 8 September 2026 (the "Final Terms").

The Base Prospectus, the Supplement and the Final Terms have been published on the website of the London Stock Exchange through a regulatory information service (www.londonstockexchange.com/exchange/news/market-news/market-news-home.html). The Base Prospectus and the Supplement are available, and the Final Terms will be available, on the website of the Issuer at: https://www.sage.com/investors/investor-centre/debt-investors/.

A copy of each of the Base Prospectus, the Supplement and the Final Terms have also been submitted to the National Storage Mechanism and are available for inspection at: https://data.fca.org.uk/#/nsm/nationalstoragemechanism.

About Sage

Sage exists to knock down barriers so everyone can thrive, starting with the millions of small and mid-sized businesses (SMBs) served by us, our partners and accountants. Customers trust our finance, HR and payroll software to make work and money flow. By digitalising business processes and relationships with customers, suppliers, employees, banks and governments, our AI-powered platform connects SMBs, removing friction and delivering insights. Knocking down barriers also means we use our time, technology and experience to tackle digital inequality, economic inequality and the climate crisis.
The Sage Group plc's LEI is 2138005RN5XYLTF8G138.
